title: Core v1.19 API Features and SDK Sync: TurboQuant, Memory Placement, IDF Corpus
mini_srs: Introduce TurboQuant compressed vector datatypes (Turbo4, Turbo8, Bits8), a unified memory placement parameter (cold/cached/pinned), and per-query IDF corpus support for sparse vector search in the qdrant gRPC API contract. The TurboQuant phase adds Turbo4 (value 4) and Turbo8 (value 5) to the Datatype enum and Bits8 (value 4) to the TurboQuantBitSize enum in collections.proto, with corresponding conversions in conversions.rs and validation in validate.rs rejecting TurboQuant on sparse configs. Memory placement unifies cold/cached/pinned into a single MemoryPlacement parameter in collections.proto. IDF corpus adds per-query idf_corpus field for BM25-style sparse vector scoring. Both SDK repositories (rust-client v1.19 sync and qdrant-client v1.19.0) consume all three contract features through regenerated bindings and updated models.
expansion_rationale: Expanded from 5 seeds (e58be0c, ad3abf7, 76f4f3e, 3631300, 589aece) with 2 non-seed TurboQuant follow-ons: 6b60fc7 adds Turbo8=5 to Datatype enum in collections.proto (patch proc_data/patches/6b60fc7.patch: collections.proto Turbo8=5, conversions.rs Datatype::Turbo8 mapping, points.proto doc update), a9ee134 adds Bits8=4 to TurboQuantBitSize enum in collections.proto (patch proc_data/patches/a9ee134.patch: collections.proto Bits8=4, conversions.rs bidirectional mapping, qdrant.rs Bits8 variant). DAG edge e58be0c->6b60fc7 (textual, files_shared=3) confirms Turbo8 directly follows Turbo4. Hard xrepo edges (ad3abf7->3631300 conf=1.0, ad3abf7->589aece conf=1.0, 76f4f3e->3631300 conf=1.0, 76f4f3e->589aece conf=1.0, e58be0c->589aece conf=0.85) force all 5 seeds into single connected component. Turbo16 (310d2d7) excluded: paths 76f4f3e->8d788c9->310d2d7 and ad3abf7->8d788c9->310d2d7 force inclusion of BM25 scoring commit 8d788c9 (G04), violating group boundaries.
